metadata.description: Autonomous multi-agent website optimiser for Claude Code. 28 sub-skills and 27 sub-agents, plus 9 optional MCP extensions (DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Banana, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Profound, Bing Webmaster, Unlighthouse, Screaming Frog). v1.0.0 adds the autonomous growth loop: plan -> audit -> fix -> test -> publish -> distribute, running unattended on a schedule from any website's own repo.
